pages.name: English: Closed
pages.notes: Plan 1 called for cxd5 with no pawn to take; plan 2 offered ...Bxc3 with the knight gone from c3 and called it securing the bishop pair; plan 3 named b4 with the bishop on it. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3. Reviewer rejection (...O-O does not keep pieces on: Nxb4) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Botvinnik System, 6...Nf6
pages.notes: Overview called it an anti-Symmetrical system; plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight; plan 2 aimed at an unrealistic ...d5. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4 around Nh4/Ne1, ...Nd4 and ...f5.

pages.name: English: Botvinnik System, 6...Nf6
pages.notes: Overview called it a reversed Dragon; plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight; plan 4 played ...f5 with the f6-knight in the way. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4. Reviewer rejection (a d6-pawn does not cover d4) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Closed, 5.d3 d6 6.Nf3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight; plan 3 aimed at an unrealistic ...d5. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Closed, 5.d3 d6 6.Nf3 Nf6 7.O-O O-O 8.Rb1 a5 9.a3
pages.notes: Plan 2 read b4/axb4 as Black moves; plan 3 sent a knight to d3, where White's pawn stands, and suggested ...d5. Rewrote plans 2-3. Reviewer rejection (Bd2/Qc2 do not prepare b4) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Closed, 5.d3 d6 6.Rb1 a5
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted Nc3 via d1 (occupied by the queen); plan 4 described a 'Botvinnik' set-up with pieces on f5, g5 and h5; plan 2 repeated the ...a5 already played. Rewrote overview and plans 2-4.

pages.name: English: Three Knights, 3...f5 4.d4 e4
pages.notes: Plan 1 read the f7 and e6 squares as moves; plan 2 relied on an open f-file that is closed by the f5-pawn. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: English: Three Knights, 3...g6 4.d4
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote castling as ...0-0 before the bishop had left f8; plan 3 was vague. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: English Opening: King's English Variation, Four Knights Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent a knight to a5 that cannot get there (the e5-knight already hits c4). Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.d4
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Bb5 through the e2-pawn. Rewrote both plans around Nxd4 with Bg5 or g3, and ...Bb4 or ...e4; British spelling.
